body: Low-bit inference on accelerators with native 4-bit support requires quantizing both weights and activations to realize the full throughput gains these formats provide. While post-training weight quantization has been extensively studied, activation quantization remains considerably more challenging and typically requires calibration data. In this work, we introduce DUALQUANT, a dual-scale, calibration-free post-training quantization framework that directly minimizes the weight-reconstruction Mean Squared Error (MSE) and, as an immediate by-product, yields per-channel activation rescalings prior to activation quantization. Our key observation is that the scaling factors obtained by minimizing weight-reconstruction error provide effective activation rescalings, enabling competitive activation quantization without calibration data. We formulate DUALQUANT as a non-differentiable weight-reconstruction problem and develop an efficient solver based on variable splitting and block coordinate descent, where each subproblem admits a closed-form update. DUALQUANT provides a unified algorithm supporting a wide range of formats, including the full MX family and NVFP4. To our knowledge, DUALQUANT is the first dual-scaling method to formally support MX and NV block formats. Across Llama and Qwen models evaluated on WikiText-2, C4, and zero-shot downstream tasks, DUALQUANT matches or exceeds the accuracy of calibration-based SmoothQuant across most models and formats, and substantially outperforms calibration-free baselines, with large gains for MX and NV block formats. We validate these gains with a real packed W4A4 inference path for Llama-3.1-8B on an RTX 4090. The resulting implementation closely matches the accuracy of fake quantization while delivering up to 2.61x memory reduction and up to 2.46x throughput speedup over BF16.
summaryZh: 本文提出DUALQUANT，一种针对大模型的双尺度、无需校准的权值与激活后训练量化框架。该方法通过最小化权值重建均方误差获得激活重缩放因子，支持包括MX家族和NVFP4在内的多种低比特格式。在Llama和Qwen模型上的实验表明，DUALQUANT在无需校准数据的情况下匹配或超越了现有校准方法的准确率，并在RTX 4090上实现了高达2.61倍的内存缩减。

glossary.explanationZh: 训练后量化，指在模型训练完成后将其权重和激活值转换为低精度表示以减少内存和计算开销。
激活量化，指对神经网络中间层的输出激活值进行量化，通常比权重量化更具挑战性。
无需校准，指量化过程不依赖代表性校准数据集来确定缩放参数。
均方误差，衡量预测值与真实值之间差异平方的平均值。
块坐标下降法，一种通过每次优化一个或一组变量来求解最优化问题的算法。
